title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch for deferred schema loading
description: Used ToolSearch (Claude Code native) to load deferred moeb MCP tool schemas. No moeb equivalent exists for this bootstrap operation.
proposed_resolution: Ensure moeb MCP tool schemas are non-deferred so ToolSearch is not needed during run sessions.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000057: ToolSearch is a legitimate pre-skill bootstrapping tool (no moeb equivalent needed); moeb-tool-origin rubric needs updating to exempt it.
